Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the election held after the 2016 Michigan Democratic primary was the 2020 United States presidential election. However, the task explicitly asked for the "58th quadrennial American presidential election" held after the Michigan Democratic primary, which is the 2016 United States presidential election itself. The Planner appears to have misunderstood the phrasing of the task, interpreting "held after the 2016 Michigan Democratic primary" as referring to the next presidential election instead of identifying the specific quadrennial election that followed the primary in the same year.
